annotation.title_clean: مفهوم الروبوت الطبي الإلكتروني "دراسة قانونية مقارنة"
annotation.title_en: The concept of electronic medical robots: a comparative legal study
annotation.venue: Al-Qadisiyah Journal for Law and Political Science
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: Comparative legal study from Mosul University defining the electronic medical robot linguistically, terminologically and legally, its features (autonomy, self-learning, algorithms) and types (surgical and healthcare robots). It recommends Iraqi legislation specific to medical robots, including an expert committee, and a clear legal definition to distinguish them from conventional medical devices.
key_provisions_or_claims: Medical robots are characterized by autonomy, self-learning and precision, plus an intangible algorithmic component.
Main types are surgical robots and healthcare robots.
Recommends a dedicated Iraqi law on medical robots.
Recommends a specialist committee of lawyers, engineers and physicians to supervise robots.
Calls for a precise legal definition separating medical robots from conventional medical devices.
